narrative.overview: The interface is an Operate-mode cockpit engineered for gaming lounge operators and cashiers working under ambient, low-light lounge lighting conditions. It balances high-velocity operational efficiency with crystal-clear station visibility across tablet screens and desktop monitors.
keyCharacteristics: Scan-First Station Grid with semantic status color anchoring
Tabular precision for countdowns, stopwatches, and Libyan Dinar (LYD) totals
Direct-touch density tailored for cashier tablets
Fast-action command modals for sessions, add-ons, and checkout

rules.name: The Single-Meaning Color Rule
rules.body: Colors carry operational meaning strictly. Green = Available, Blue = Prepaid Active, Purple = Postpaid Active, Amber = Expiring, Red = Rogue Play. Never use these semantic hues decoratively.

rules.name: The Currency Clarity Rule
rules.body: All monetary values are rendered in Libyan Dinar (LYD) with explicit formatting (e.g. 12.500 LYD or 12.500 د.ل) in tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Every live clock, countdown timer, running stopwatch, and currency amount MUST use tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) to prevent visual jitter.

rules.name: The State-Anchored Border Rule
rules.body: Station cards express operational state through a 1.5px state-colored accent border and tinted header pill, avoiding eye-fatiguing full-card saturation floods.

dos: Do format all currency explicitly in Libyan Dinar (LYD / د.ل) with 3-decimal precision.
Do enforce tabular-nums on all timers, stopwatches, and price displays.
Do provide instant visual feedback on all touchscreen cashier buttons.
Do calculate change automatically in the checkout modal when cash is received.
Do offer 1-tap quick time extension buttons (+15m, +30m, +1h) for active prepaid sessions.
donts: Don't use generic modals for simple inline actions.
Don't use decorative gradients on text or un-anchored glowing borders.
Don't allow timers to drift on client refresh: compute from authoritative server timestamps.
Don't allow checkout settlement without recording the active cashier and shift ID.
